description: This file contains functions related to configuring repository settings in a Git-like version control system. It manages reading, setting, and clearing various repository configuration options, including boolean, integer, unsigned long, and string settings, along with some logic for default values and environment variables.

methods.name: void repo_cfg_bool(struct repository * r,const char * key,int * dest,int def)
methods.description: Sets a boolean repository configuration value, defaulting if the config is missing.

methods.name: void repo_cfg_int(struct repository * r,const char * key,int * dest,int def)
methods.description: Sets an integer repository configuration value, defaulting if missing.

methods.name: void repo_cfg_ulong(struct repository * r,const char * key,unsigned long * dest,unsigned long def)
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long repository configuration value, defaulting if missing.

methods.name: void prepare_repo_settings(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Initializes or updates the repository settings based on configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: void repo_settings_clear(struct repository * r)
methods.description: Resets repository settings to their initial empty state.

methods.name: unsigned long repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns the configured big file size threshold for the repository.

methods.name: void repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold(struct repository * repo,unsigned long value)
methods.description: Sets the big file size threshold for the repository.

methods.name: enum:log_refs_config repo_settings_get_log_all_ref_updates(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns the log update policy for references in this repository.

methods.name: int repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns whether to warn about ambiguous references.

methods.name: const char * repo_settings_get_hooks_path(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns the hooks path for this repository.

methods.name: int repo_settings_get_shared_repository(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns the sharing mode of the repository.

methods.name: void repo_settings_set_shared_repository(struct repository * repo,int value)
methods.description: Sets the sharing mode of the repository.

methods.name: void repo_settings_reset_shared_repository(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Resets the shared repository setting to its default state.

ctags.name: repo_cfg_bool
ctags.pattern: /^static void repo_cfg_bool(struct repository *r, const char *key, int *dest,$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const char * key,int * dest,int def)

ctags.pattern: /^static void repo_cfg_int(struct repository *r, const char *key, int *dest,$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const char * key,int * dest,int def)

ctags.pattern: /^static void repo_cfg_ulong(struct repository *r, const char *key, unsigned long *dest,$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,const char * key,unsigned long * dest,unsigned long def)
